content: We apply the proposed method to create a large translation parallel corpus which contains INLINEFORM0 1.24M bilingual sentence pairs. To our best knowledge, this is the first large high-quality ancient-modern Chinese dataset. Furthermore, we test SMT models and various NMT models on the created dataset and provide a strong baseline for this task.
